name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys's path to motorsport HR wasn't exactly linear. He started out studying engineering, but quickly realized his true passion lay in understanding and motivating people. After a brief stint in general HR, a chance encounter at a rally event sparked a fascination with the high-pressure, high-stakes world of racing. He saw an opportunity to apply his people skills in a field that demanded peak performance.

At Cool Racing, Rhys is known for his meticulous approach to recruitment and talent development. He believes in finding individuals not just with the right skills, but with the right mindset to thrive under pressure. His focus is on building a team where everyone feels valued, supported, and driven to excel, fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the organization. What sets Rhys apart is his understanding of the unique challenges and rewards of a motorsport career. He knows that fostering a positive team dynamic is essential for success on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part
physical.description: Rhys is of average height, with a thoughtful expression and a sharp, professional demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Prefers conducting interviews while walking around the paddock to get a feel for the atmosphere.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
